aboutText: GoPoxy is a Mickleham-based epoxy flooring specialist delivering premium concrete coatings for residential and commercial spaces across Melbourne, Perth, Sydney and Adelaide. Led by Tarvinder, our team focuses on high-quality garage floors, interior coatings and heavy-duty surfaces built to withstand hot tyres and heavy vehicles. We pride ourselves on professional workmanship, clear communication and competitive pricing that Mickleham homeowners trust.
servicesText: From garage transformations to full interior epoxy solutions, GoPoxy provides tailored concrete coatings for homes and businesses across Mickleham and greater Melbourne.

services.title: Residential Garage Epoxy
services.desc: Transform your Mickleham garage with a premium epoxy floor coating built to handle daily wear and hot tyres.

services.title: Commercial Epoxy Coatings
services.desc: Durable, chemical-resistant epoxy flooring for workshops, showrooms and commercial spaces across Melbourne.

services.title: Heavy Vehicle Epoxy Floors
services.desc: Reinforced epoxy coatings engineered to support heavy vehicles, trucks and machinery without cracking.

services.title: Hot Tyre Resistant Coatings
services.desc: Specialist coatings that prevent hot tyre transfer and keep your Mickleham garage floor looking pristine.

services.desc: Custom epoxy flooring packages for new builds and renovations throughout Mickleham and Melbourne.
